__comment: Presentation weather: visible precipitation and contextual sound; does not create simulated flood water. Scheduled and saved by WeatherManager.
precipitation is drawn by WeatherPrecipitation (doc 24, 'Rain and snow'). intensity is the share of the drop budget shown;
height and speed are the fall column (blocks) and fall speed (blocks/s); slant is sideways blocks per block of fall;
width_px and length_px are streak sizes in pixels of a 1080-line screen; splash/ripple seconds are the rings on ground and water.
